title: Silver Account: Platinum Rewards Card holder benefits
summary: This document explains enhanced Silver Account benefits for customers who also hold a Platinum Rewards Card. When both are linked under the same profile, monthly free withdrawals increase to 10+5=15, up to 15 ATM fee rebates apply, and a 0.025% relationship bonus is added to APY (plus shows card APY bonuses of +0.2% for Platinum Rewards, +0.25% for Diamond Elite).
